given: the stock API after the tracking-code split
when: an API client fetches a stock record
then: the response no longer includes a combined inventory_code field; batch_number and serial_number are the tracking identifiers returned in its place

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 assert the new fields are present and correctly valued; this AC asserts the old combined field is absent. A response could carry batch_number and serial_number while still echoing inventory_code, passing the prior ACs but failing this one, so the removal is independently observable and breakable. (Feature-level open question: whether inventory_code is kept for backward compatibility.)

architectural_notes: API/boundary AC asserting a negative response-contract guarantee on the stock endpoint (app/routes/): the retired inventory_code key must be absent. Aligned with S1's schema drop of inventory_code (the column no longer exists on app/models/, so the repository cannot supply it) — the boundary serializer exposes only batch_number/serial_number. Owner module: the stock response serializer / API contract. Cross-cutting concern: backward-compatibility of the response contract — flagged as the PO Gate-2 decision on whether inventory_code is retained; recommendation is to drop it (clean split, no legacy echo). Verified by an R4 real-branch test asserting the key's absence.
